title: ModelProfile
description: The data payload of `dmtool -m <model> profile extract`: a domain-blind model complexity profile used by `profile synthesize` and `profile compare`. It contains structural and program-shape counts only, never domain identifiers or values.

distribution.description: A tail-preserving summary of integer measurements (percentiles by nearest-rank).

buckets.description: log-scaled buckets (1, 2-3, 4-7, 8-15, …) keeping the silhouette compact

histogram.description: a name→count map; keys are kernel operator ids / construct names / kind names (never domain identifiers)

distributionMap.description: a class-key → distribution map — a distribution SPLIT by a class the single combined distribution would conflate (e.g. chainProductByDepth's nesting-depth classes, whose scales structurally differ)

nestedHistogram.description: a construct × scope-class JOINT: scope-class name → (construct → count). Recovers what the separate scope and construct marginals can't — e.g. an AGGREGATE evaluated per repeatable row (the O(N²) hotspot) vs at model level (cheap).

scaleMatch.description: the scale JOINT for aggregating computations: whether the computed field's declared scale equals the summed cell's — the fact deciding an interpreter rescale (and, for synthesis, a scale-fix round).

matched.description: computed-field scale equals the summed cell's scale (no rescale/round)

iteration.description: the ITERATION-COST signal — where the interpreter's real O(N)/O(N²) work lives (so a synthetic model reproduces the expensive shapes, not just their counts).

parallelIteration.description: count referencing fields in ≥2 sibling repeatable branches — a cross-list join (O(N×M))

outerCorrelation.description: count using the `$` outer-iteration correlation (`CurrentRepetition($G)` / `$Group*` in a filter) — the explicit self-join, the sharpest O(N²) signal

listScanCapacity.description: Per rule or computation, the greatest bounded collection size explicitly scanned by an aggregate, quantifier, group-presence operation, or root-group count. Scalar references do not count.

scopeCapacity.description: Per rule or computation, the bounded repeatability product of its own scope; 1 outside repeatable scope.

workCapacity.description: Per rule or computation, the saturated product of scopeCapacity and listScanCapacity.

scannedScopeCapacity.description: scopeCapacity restricted to programs whose listScanCapacity is greater than 1; empty when no program scans a non-trivial collection.

scope.description: how often an element evaluates: model-level / non-repeating group / per repeatable row

modelLevel.description: scoped at the root group — evaluated once

perRepeatableRow.description: scoped within/at a repeatable group — evaluated per row

structure.description: the static shape: size, nesting, field kinds, repeatability, and declared-constraint prevalence

unboundedCount.description: repeatable groups with no positive max (effectively unbounded rows)

maxRepetitions.description: declared max rows over the bounded repeatable groups

nestingDepth.description: per repeatable group, its repeatable-ancestor count — how deeply nested each is (a flat model has many at 1; a deeply-nested one skews the tail)

chainProduct.description: per repeatable group (n = repeatable groups), the PRODUCT of maxRepetitions over its repeatable ancestors-or-self (root-to-group cumulative) — disambiguates whether a high listScanCapacity comes from one huge rep or a chain of moderate ones

fieldChainProduct.description: per field (n = ALL fields), the same chain product for its containing chain — 1 when under no repeatable; the field-mass placement signal

siblingBranchFan.description: per group with fan ≥1 (n = such groups), the number of DISTINCT repeatable branch roots reachable through non-repeatable descent only — how many twin/multi-way aggregate hubs the model has

chainProductByDepth.description: chainProduct SPLIT by nestingDepth class ("1" / "2-3" / "4+") — depth-1 (root) positions carry just their own size while nested positions carry a multi-factor product, so the combined distribution's median/p90 conflate two structurally different scales; a synthesizer sizing a root specifically needs the depth-1 sub-distribution, not a value drawn from the whole (nested-dominated) mix

nestingDepthExact.description: nestingDepth's EXACT per-depth-value histogram ("1" → count, "2" → count, …) — depth is a tiny-range small integer, so an exact count map is cheap and closes the bucket-ambiguity a log-scaled distribution's bucket (e.g. "2-3" blending two different true depths) would otherwise introduce

constraints.description: declared-constraint prevalence — presence + scale + enum cardinality only (values stripped)

numbersWithBounds.description: number fields with a min and/or max

stringsWithLength.description: string fields with a min/max length

stringsWithPattern.description: string fields with a regex pattern (the pattern itself is not emitted)

numberScale.description: declared decimal scale over number fields

enumCardinality.description: value count per enumeration field (the values themselves are not emitted)

opaqueCount.description: rules rulekit could not model (reported, never dropped) — a coverage signal

modelLevel.description: scoped at the root group — evaluated once

perRepeatableRow.description: scoped within/at a repeatable group — evaluated per row

rulesPerErrorField.description: concentration — how many rules share each error field

walkUpDistance.description: cross-level: group levels a rule reaches above its scope (n = number of rules that walk up; B4)

repeatableLevelsCrossed.description: most repeatable-group levels any referenced path crosses — the deep-star/iteration signal (B5)

operators.description: kernel operator id → total occurrences across all conditions

constructs.description: performance-sensitive construct → number of rules containing it (AGGREGATE, QUANTIFIER, GROUP_FILL, CURRENT_REPETITION, SEMANTIC_INDEX, FILTER, UNIQUENESS, PATTERN, VALUE_LIST, DATE_MATH, ARITHMETIC, CUSTOM)

constructCombos.description: co-occurrence JOINT: sorted +-joined construct set per rule → count (`NONE` = a plain rule; e.g. `AGGREGATE+FILTER` vs `FILTER`). Reveals what the `constructs` marginal only lets you subtract.

constructsByScope.description: construct × scope-class joint — the O(N²) predictor (an aggregate per repeatable row vs at model level)

iteration.description: iteration-cost: star-capture (elements walked) + parallel/`$` cross-list joins

computations.description: the computation population's complexity signal, plus the dependency-cascade depth (B7)

nodeCount.description: AST node count per computation (preconditions + operation)

maxCascadeDepth.description: longest computed-on-computed dependency chain (1 = no computation reads another)

feedingOthers.description: computed fields read by another computation's formula

computedFieldKinds.description: value-kind → count of the COMPUTED fields (NUMBER, STRING, DATE, …) — independent of count; answers 'are all computed fields numbers?'

alternatives.description: number of when/calc branches per computation (1 = a single formula; higher = a many-way conditional)

scope.description: how often a computation evaluates — a per-repeatable-row computation runs once per row (the N-row × computation cost)

preconditionedCount.description: computations that are conditional at all (a common precondition or ≥1 preconditioned alternative)

archetypes.description: operation-shape histogram → count of computations (COPY, AGGREGATE, ARITHMETIC, DATE, STRING, CONSTANT) — a direct synthesis target the operator+construct marginals blur

constructCombos.description: co-occurrence JOINT: sorted +-joined construct set per computation → count (`NONE` = a bare copy/constant)

constructsByScope.description: construct × scope-class joint — the O(N²) predictor for computations (an aggregate re-evaluated per repeatable row)

aggregateScaleMatch.description: scale JOINT over aggregating computations — matched vs mismatched computed/summed scale

iteration.description: iteration-cost: star-capture (elements walked) + parallel/`$` cross-list joins

aggregateStars.description: n = computations with ≥1 starred operand path: the MAX count of starred (`*`) segments in a single referenced path (1 = a plain flatten, ≥2 = a nested-star aggregate) — decides whether a multi-star nested-aggregate recipe is needed

wiring.description: how densely fields feed rules/computations — a model where most fields are live is a different eval than one where most are inert

fieldsReferenced.description: fields touched by any rule or computation (condition, operation, error/computed field)

fieldFanOut.description: per referenced field, how many distinct rules + computations touch it (the 'edit field X → re-evaluate N' surface)
